name: Anime Pantsu Detective
source:
"Are you ready for anything for your own goal?"
Can you find all the panties of anime girl? Or maybe you came here for another purpose? Only one fact is known. This mobile game can be completed only by the most steel guys. All or Nothing! Prove your intellect! Find all Panties in this good Adventure Quest game! Conquer and kiss the girl! Become a True Pantsu Detective!
translation:
“你愿意为自己的目标做任何事吗？”

你能找齐所有动漫女孩的内裤吗？还是另有目的？唯一确定的是，这款手机游戏只有意志如钢的男人才能通关。要么全有，要么全无！证明你的智慧！在这款优秀的冒险任务游戏中找出所有内裤！征服并亲吻女孩！成为真正的内裤侦探！
